name: Winter's Last Petal
description: A katana found mid-draw, frozen in the moment its owner fell.

passive.name: First Frost
passive.description: First attack each battle always applies Freeze.

resonance.description: Glacial Waltz hits twice on frozen targets.

name: The Laughing Lantern
description: A funeral lantern that refuses to go out. It smells like incense and iron.

passive.name: Premature Bloom
passive.description: Blood Blossom passive activates at 60% HP instead of 50.

resonance.description: Spirit Soother steals 50% of damage as HP instead of 35%.

name: Chain of Ten Thousand Nights
description: Two thousand years of use have worn it smooth. It weighs nothing to its owner.

passive.name: Iron Echo
passive.description: Reflect 20% of physical damage received back to attacker.

resonance.description: Mastery of Pain also reduces all incoming damage by 15% for 2 turns.

name: Tide Caller
description: A staff carved from driftwood from a coast that no longer exists.

passive.name: Oceanic Grace
passive.description: Healing abilities restore 5 MP to the target as well.

resonance.description: Hajra's Hymn cooldown reduced to 1 instead of 2.

name: Eidolons' Grimoire
description: A tome with heavy silver locks. Its pages smell of dry lightning and ozone.

passive.name: Mana Flow
passive.description: Reduces MP cost of all summon spells by 15%.

resonance.description: Summoned Eidolons gain +10% ATK and SPD while active.

name: Aegis of the Archangel
description: A light-infused spear forged in a golden tower before the sky cracked.

passive.name: Righteous Judgment
passive.description: Reflects 15% of magical damage received as Holy damage.

resonance.description: Raises the stun chance of Divine Execution to 60%.

name: Wyrmtooth Lance
description: Forged from the calcified tooth of a dragon, still warm with dragonfire.

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.description: Gains a +15% SPD boost on the turn following a Dragon's Leap strike.

resonance.description: The 3rd-turn Dragon's Leap strike becomes an AoE slash hitting all front-row enemies.

name: Arren's Oath
description: The sacred greatsword carried by the first King of Aethoria. Its steel remembers every promise.

passive.name: Sovereign Grace
passive.description: Increases allies' HP regeneration from Rex's passive to +25% and shields adjacent allies, absorbing 15% of their damage.

resonance.description: Divine Blade attacks shred 30% of the target's physical DEF for 3 turns.

name: Azure Vanguard Standard
description: The heavy banner carried at the front of the Azure Regiment. Still holds the scent of pine and battle.

passive.name: Unbroken Wall
passive.description: Grants Sera a permanent 15% physical damage mitigation.

resonance.description: Activating Commander's Aegis grants a flat +30 DEF shield to the entire party for 2 turns.
